summary.en: Reuse a parent interface, override behavior in subclasses and accept compatible objects through duck typing.
summary.bn: প্যারেন্ট ক্লাসের কাজ ব্যবহার করো, সাবক্লাসে মেথড বদলাও এবং একই মেথড থাকা ভিন্ন অবজেক্ট নিয়ে কাজ করো।

notes: The examples use single inheritance on Python 3.10–3.12; super follows the MRO, including in more complex hierarchies.

sections.title: One request, several kinds of answer
Extend a class and initialize its part
Reuse a contract without repeating the caller
Ask what an object can do
Trace the receiver through inherited code
Keep the operation stable as implementations vary

examples.title: Add a lab charge to the base fee
examples.explanationHtml: The same fee call returns 3000 for Course and 3500 for LabCourse. The override adds its charge to the base calculation.

examples.title: Observe an extended method call
examples.explanationHtml: The override calls the base method first, so base appears before urgent. Both methods act on one Urgent instance.

examples.title: Accept unrelated label providers
examples.explanationHtml: Room and Team have no custom shared parent. show_label only needs the label operation and prints each returned string.

examples.title: Compose a student with a wallet
examples.explanationHtml: A Student holds a Wallet as an attribute. Its balance is available through that helper, while isinstance confirms Student is not a Wallet subtype.

practice.title: Extend a course charge
practice.statementHtml: Read credits from 0 to 6 and a nonnegative lab charge up to 5000. Base Course.fee returns credits times 1000. Override fee in LabCourse using super and print the total.
hints: Initialize the inherited credits before computing the fee.

practice.title: Choose a ticket method
practice.statementHtml: Read REGULAR or STUDENT, then a base price from 0 to 10000 on the next line. Ticket.cost returns the price. StudentTicket overrides cost to return integer floor division of price by two. Print the chosen object’s cost.
hints: Make one object, then use the same cost call.

practice.title: Total compatible measurements
practice.statementHtml: Read a line of nonnegative integers, possibly empty. Wrap values alternately as Box and Packet objects; both expose weight(). Print their total using one function that calls weight, without checking types.
hints: The total function depends only on weight().

practice.title: Preserve a two-stage report
practice.statementHtml: Read a roll from 1 to 999 and a mark from 0 to 100. Base Record.report returns the roll as a string. MarkedRecord initializes both fields and extends report through super to return roll:mark. Print it.
hints: Extend the returned string rather than calling self.report recursively.

quiz.prompt: Is an instance also a member of its parent family?
In which order do the extended show methods print?
quiz.explanation: The explicit super call executes the base method before the second print.

quiz.prompt: What does duck typing require from a label consumer?
quiz.explanation: Supported behavior matters to the call; ancestry is optional.

quiz.prompt: Why call super().__init__ in a new child initializer?
options: To perform the inherited initialization explicitly
To create a separate parent instance
quiz.explanation: The new initializer replaces the inherited initializer unless it calls it.
super continues lookup after the current class in the MRO.

quiz.prompt: Which relationship is better expressed by composition?
options: A lab course is a course
A student ticket is a ticket
A child class extends a parent
quiz.explanation: Holding a helper as an attribute models has-a.

quiz.prompt: Why is self.fee() dangerous inside an unconditional fee override?
options: It calls the same override recursively
quiz.explanation: Normal lookup starts at the receiving object again.

quiz.prompt: What should an override preserve for existing callers?
options: A compatible signature and result meaning
quiz.explanation: A subtype must remain useful under the operation contract.

quiz.prompt: How does type(x) is Base differ from isinstance(x, Base)?
quiz.explanation: Exact type identity is narrower than family membership.

keyPoints.en: A subclass can reuse behavior from its parent.
keyPoints.bn: সাবক্লাস প্যারেন্ট ক্লাসের মেথড ব্যবহার করতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: An override supplies behavior for the receiving object’s type.
keyPoints.bn: মেথড ওভাররাইড করলে অবজেক্টের ক্লাস অনুযায়ী কাজ বেছে নেওয়া হয়।

keyPoints.en: super() continues lookup after the current class in the method resolution order.
keyPoints.bn: super() মেথড খোঁজার ক্রমে বর্তমান ক্লাসের পর থেকে খোঁজে।

keyPoints.en: Parent initialization is not automatically added to a new subclass initializer.
keyPoints.bn: সাবক্লাসে নতুন __init__ লিখলে প্যারেন্টের __init__ নিজে থেকে চলে না।

keyPoints.en: Duck typing depends on supported operations rather than family membership.
keyPoints.bn: ডাক টাইপিংয়ে অবজেক্ট কোন কাজ পারে সেটাই দরকার, একই প্যারেন্ট থাকা লাগে না।
এক অবজেক্টের ভেতরে অন্য অবজেক্ট রাখলে তাদের সম্পর্ক বোঝাতে কম্পোজিশন কাজে লাগে।

examQuestions.question: Explain overriding and duck typing with a fee-reporting function.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Overriding defines a fee method on a child class that replaces the inherited method during lookup. Duck typing allows any compatible object with fee() to join the report, even without the same custom parent.

examQuestions.question: Explain why a subclass initializer must preserve parent state.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A new __init__ is selected instead of the inherited one. Calling super().__init__ with the required arguments sets the parent attributes on the same instance. Without that work, inherited methods may fail when they read missing attributes.

examQuestions.question: Would you inherit Student from Wallet? Explain a better design.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A Student has a Wallet but cannot replace a Wallet under its normal interface. Store a Wallet in student.wallet and delegate balance operations to it. This keeps student identity separate from the helper managing money.
